purpose: Native evidence for the E2 CUP calibration-group solve. Sonnet Lite 18.53 solves an interior open-edge simplified co-calibrated port (CUPGRP g1, GNDREF BOX AUTO, SIMPLE Y) and reports both de-embedded (D) and raw (ND) responses. The D-minus-ND difference isolates Lite's port-discontinuity removal: a pure lumped launch-junction capacitance dy11 = -5.9545e-9*f Siemens (~0.95fF, exactly proportional to f across 1MHz-10GHz, quantized per contact cell). DiffMoM measures the same junction as the launch cells' in-situ self-capacitance marginal (full host pad minus pad stripped of port cells, through a separate cover-contact column) and removes ~1.5x Lite's value — a bounded basis-resolution residual in the same family as the A7 pin-feed gap. Parity bounds: calibrated-vs-D |dS| <= 2e-4 at 1GHz, <= 2e-3 at 10GHz; raw-vs-ND |dS| <= 2e-4 at 1GHz, <= 2e-3 at 10GHz.
